properties.title: Articulations
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Accents, heavy accents and staccato on both staves.

properties.title: Bass
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A four-string bass: bass clef an octave down over a four-line tab.

properties.title: Beams and Flags
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Beams over groups of eighths and sixteenths, flags on single notes, mixed groups.

properties.title: Beat Text
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Text above beats, next to chord names and tempo.

properties.title: Bends
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Full, half and released bends, with their arrows and labels.

properties.title: Chord Names
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Chord names over their beats, never pushed sideways, and the diagrams in the header.

properties.title: Chords and Accidentals
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Chords, sharps, flats and naturals in C, accidentals carried through the bar.

properties.title: Band
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The dark page (View → Dark Page) with four tracks together, names at each system. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Dead, Ghost and Palm Mute
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Dead notes (x), ghost notes in parentheses and palm mutes (P.M.).

properties.title: Dots and Ties
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Dotted and double-dotted notes, ties inside a bar and across the bar line.

properties.title: Drop D and Capo
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Drop D tuning with a capo: tuning and capo in the header.

properties.title: Drums
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A drum kit on the percussion clef: kick, snare, hi-hat, toms and cymbals.

properties.title: Dynamics Hidden
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The same dynamics with View → Dynamics off: none drawn. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Dynamics
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Dynamics from ppp to fff, marked only where they change.

properties.title: Effects Together
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A dense lick with several effects on neighbouring notes: lanes above the tab.

properties.title: Band
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Eight tracks together: guitars, bass, drums, piano on a grand staff, strings, voice, acoustic tab. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Empty Bars
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Bars with only rests: a whole rest, a dotted half rest filling 3/4, rests after a note.

properties.title: Four Voices
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Four voices: 1 and 3 up, 2 and 4 down, voices that rest for a whole bar hidden.

properties.title: Grace Notes
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Grace notes before beats, alone and before chords, on both staves.

properties.title: Hammer-on and Pull-off
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Hammer-ons and pull-offs, single and in chains, with the arcs and H and P.

properties.title: Harmonics
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Natural, artificial and pinch harmonics.

properties.title: Header and Credits
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A full header: title, subtitle, artist, album, words, music, copyright, tabber, tuning.

properties.title: Key Signatures
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Key changes through sharps and flats, with naturals cancelling the old key.

properties.title: Horizontal
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The Horizontal layout: every bar on one line, no header. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Parchment
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The Parchment layout: page-wide lines on one sheet, no page breaks. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Vertical
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The Vertical layout: lines as wide as a narrow window, no pages. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Let Ring
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Let ring over arpeggios.

properties.title: Lyrics
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A voice with lyrics under the staff, syllables split by hyphens.

properties.title: Band
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: The user's notation per track: the lead as tab only, the bass as standard only. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Notes and Rests
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Whole to sixty-fourth notes and rests on standard notation and tablature.

properties.title: Page Breaks
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Thirty-two bars over pages, with page numbers.

properties.title: Letter Paper
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: US Letter paper instead of A4. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Piano
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A piano with one staff in the file, split over a grand staff by hand range.

properties.title: Repeats and Endings
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Repeat signs, a repeat played three times, first and second endings, a double bar.

properties.title: Rhythm on Tab
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A tab-only track: rhythm stems above for voice 1, below for voice 2, rests outside the staff.

properties.title: Sections and Directions
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Rehearsal letters with section names; segno and coda signs at the start of their bars, To Coda, Fine and D.S. al Coda at the end of theirs.

properties.title: Seven String
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A seven-string guitar: seven tab lines and its tuning in the header.

properties.title: Slides
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Shift and legato slides between notes, slides into and out of a note.

properties.title: Standard Only
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A guitar saved with standard notation only: no tablature drawn.

properties.title: Violin and Cello
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Two instruments without strings: treble clef and bass clef staves together. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Strums and Techniques
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Strums up and down, slap, pop and tapping.

properties.title: Band
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Twelve tracks in one system, taller than the page at full size: the staff shrinks to fit. What this file tests is how OxiGuitar shows it (its layout, paper, page colour or tracks shown), not the file: in Guitar Pro or anywhere else it is an ordinary score.

properties.title: Tempo Changes
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A labelled starting tempo, then changes at a bar and in the middle of one.

properties.title: Time Signatures
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: 4/4, 3/4, 6/8, 5/4, 7/8, 2/2 and 12/8 in a row.

properties.title: Tremolo Picking
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Tremolo picking at eighth, sixteenth and thirty-second speeds.

properties.title: Triplets
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Eighth, quarter and sixteenth triplets, and a triplet with a rest in it.

properties.title: Two Voices
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Two voices on one staff: voice 1 stems up, voice 2 stems down, rests moved aside.

properties.title: Unusual Tuplets
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Quintuplets, sextuplets, septuplets, a duplet and a 5:3 ratio (marked n:m).

properties.title: Vibrato and Trill
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: Vibrato on single notes and long notes, and trills with their other fret.

properties.title: Whammy and Fade In
properties.instructions: OxiGuitar test file: A whammy-bar dive and a fade-in.
